players.product: OSAT (incl. JCET STATS ChipPAC Korea) - package substrate buyer from Simmtech and Daeduck Electronics

quarterly_data.signal: The company (H1 2026 results briefing, answers to pre-collected questions) on co-packaged optics: it has a CPO technology layout on the same level as the world's leading OSATs and has carried out years of deep joint R&D with several leading customers (not named); over the past half year it made significant breakthroughs in improving reliability and optimising cost structure while focusing on building CPO optoelectronic test capability. Customer products are still at the system-validation stage in computing centers, have not reached large-scale mass production and make no actual revenue contribution yet; future revenue depends on customers' validation progress and ramp pace. On thermal management, which it calls one of the core technical difficulties of CPO and decisive for long-term reliability, it is working on materials (thermal properties, thermo-electrical matching between chips and with the substrate) and design (a thermal-electrical feedback mechanism and differentiated stacking structures on its advanced packaging platform to lower system thermal resistance).

CEO Zheng Li (H1 2026 results briefing): the company announced in June 2026 a second high-end advanced packaging-and-test plant in the Lingang area and is pressing ahead with civil construction to complete the capacity build-out as soon as possible, to reserve capacity for future needs.
